name: Electric V-Comb Anti Lice Machine | Chemical-Free Safe Lice & Egg Removal Device
description:
Say goodbye to lice safely with the Electric V-Comb Anti Lice Machine. Designed with stainless steel teeth and a gentle suction system, it removes lice and eggs instantly without chemicals or pesticides. Suitable for children and adults, this device captures lice into disposable filters for clean, mess-free disposal. Compact, lightweight, and reusable, it’s a smart solution for families.
Key Features
 100% chemical-free and pesticide-free, safe for all ages
 Stainless steel teeth with rounded edges, gentle on scalp
 Built-in vacuum suctions lice and eggs into sealed filters
 Compact, lightweight, and easy-to-use handheld design
 LED illumination for clear visibility of captured lice
 Reusable device with replaceable hygienic filters
Ingredients / Materials
Stainless steel teeth, ABS plastic body, electronic motor, replaceable filters
How to Use
 Use only on dry hair for best results
 Attach a disposable capture filter to the device
 Comb through hair slowly from scalp to ends
 Dispose of the used filter securely after each use
Package Includes
 1 × V-Comb Device
 2 × Disposable Capture Filters
 1 × Storage Box
 1 × Instruction Manual
